answer: Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the sonnet beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. Rotation is recorded in the nadir index and the hollow audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 365 keys live and online for the whole period, thus the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. That is 7 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
